title: Essay editor: draft paragraphs cannot be reviewed without restoring them (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
The essay editor allows me to move paragraphs into draft. But there is no way to  review the paragrahphs there. This means that I have to restore them to see what's in them. 

In a complex essay, I need to be able to switch paragraphs in antd out to see how they flow. If I cannot see them, I can loose my place. I need to be able to expand or preview a draft paragraph without restoring it.
